newsitem.title: FRANCE: Wildcat strike shuts Eiffel Tower.
newsitem.headline: Wildcat strike shuts Eiffel Tower.

text.p: A surprise employees' strike on Wednesday closed Paris's Eiffel Tower, arguably the world's most popular fee-charging tourist attraction.
The strike was called to protest against the sacking last month of an employee who manhandled a British woman tourist who tried to get out of a lift as the doors were about to close.
The 320-metre (1,050 ft) tower is operated by a private firm which has a concession from the owner, the city of Paris.
The operators said they did not know how long the strike was likely to last.

They say that with 5.5 million visitors a year, the tower beats any other paying attraction in the world. Ticket sales in the current peak season are estimated at around a million francs ($600,000) daily.
